items.topic: Sessions: reading the model via CLI instead of parsing graphql JSON
items.claim: Most common CLI failure (~204 times in ~75 sessions) is scripts parsing graphql JSON output and crashing on null; 'graphql' verb accounts for 124 audit-log failures, 'query' 44, update 36, create 27
items.fact: Catalog should teach `query esm --select --where`, `status --json` and `mermaid` for reading the model; multiple where filters are ANDed; graphql --schema exports schema, --introspect runs introspection; ESM loads at server startup while PSM/ASM/RDBMS/UI load on first query; `create -t DataMember|OneWayRelationMember --set isQuery=true` calls EsmUtils createQuery/createComplexQuery; if status stays dirty after save/discard remove .<model>.model.dirty by hand and restart server; -s/--vars values are kept verbatim.
